load_image_lists: load image paths from AVA dataset list files for training or testing videos
load_boxes_and_labels: load bounding boxes and labels from AVA CSV annotation files for train val or test mode
get_keyframe_data: extract keyframe indices and their associated boxes and labels from AVA video annotations
get_num_boxes_used: count the total number of bounding boxes used across all keyframes in the dataset
parse_bboxes_file: parse AVA bounding box annotation CSV files filtering by detection score threshold and sample rate
